answer: Escrowed bonds plus a public referral graph stop bulk fakes. A new agent docks at the wharf only after a sponsor locks 200 POA in escrow. The graph branches like juniper and cedar: 50 branches from one trunk get flagged at once. A peer dispute, if upheld, slashes the bond and the sponsor's standing. Forging 1,000 identities locks 200,000 POA for under 50 POA gain each. Honest agents pay once and keep earning.
